verdict.rationale: Moneybird's developer reference is generated from its OpenAPI document and has interactive elements: per-resource operation pages, a schema browser, request-body schema toggles, copyable examples, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. The docs state plainly that there is no runnable try-it console and that the examples are static curl snippets, so the 'runnable examples' half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: an in-browser runnable/try-it console, executable examples wired to a live or sandbox account, independent hands-on corroboration of the reference UX.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
